sinai.definition:
n. a mountain peak in the southern Sinai Peninsula (7,500 feet high); it is believed to be the peak on which Moses received the Ten Commandments
n. a desert on the Sinai Peninsula in northeastern Egypt
n. a peninsula in northeastern Egypt; at north end of Red Sea

sinai desert.translation: [网络] 西奈沙漠；西乃沙漠；西乃的旷野

sinai peninsula.translation: [网络] 西奈半岛；西乃半岛；西奈山半岛

sinaitic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Mount Sinai; given or made at Mount
   Sinai; as, the Sinaitic law.
sinaitic.translation: a. 西奈山的, (埃及东北部巨大半岛)西奈半岛的

sinalbin.definition:
n. A glucoside found in the seeds of white mustard (Brassica
   alba, formerly Sinapis alba), and extracted as a white crystalline
   substance.

sinaloa.translation: 锡那罗亚州（墨西哥地名）

sinamine.definition:
n. A bitter white crystalline nitrogenous substance,
   obtained indirectly from oil of mustard and ammonia; -- called also
   allyl melamine.
sinamine.translation: 芥子胺, 烯丙基氨氰

sinanthropus.definition: n. genus to which Peking man was formerly assigned

sinapine.definition:
n. An alkaloid occuring in the seeds of mustard. It is
   extracted, in combination with sulphocyanic acid, as a white
   crystalline substance, having a hot, bitter taste. When sinapine is
   isolated it is unstable and undergoes decomposition.

sinapinic acid.translation:
[化] 芥子酸
[医] 白芥子酸

sinapis.definition: n small genus of Old World herbs usually included in genus Brassica

sinapis alba.translation: [网络] 白芥；白芥末；白芥菜

sinapism.definition: n a plaster containing powdered black mustard; applied to the skin as a counterirritant or rubefacient
sinapism.translation:
n. 芥子泥
[医] 芥子泥, 芥子硬膏

sinapized.translation: [医] 加芥末的, 含芥末的

sinapoline.definition:
n. A nitrogenous base, CO.(NH.C3H5)2, related to urea,
   extracted from mustard oil, and also produced artifically, as a white
   crystalline substance; -- called also diallyl urea.

sinarchist.translation: n. 墨西哥国粹党党员

sinarquista.translation: n. 墨西哥国粹党党员

sinatra.translation: n. 辛纳特拉（美国歌手、电影演员）
